async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the search box in the complementary section and fill with 'reveals'
    search_box = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await search_box.fill("reveals")
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button in the complementary section
    search_button = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Step 3: Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Click on the third result
    # Assuming search results are links, get all links and click the third one (index 2)
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-based index
    await third_link.click()
    
    # Step 5: Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
